args.title: Summary: Saltmarsh Foods — Warehouse Automation in 2026
args.body:
- Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers "Warehouse automation in 2026" (https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse).
- The article reports pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion) notes the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
